Every operation of the agent protocol with its access level, parameters and response shape, rendered from the tool table and the OpenAPI document.

_Generated by `scripts/gen_skill_reference.py` from `docs/openapi/agent-protocol.json` and the tool table. Do not edit by hand._

Base URL `https://api.app.membase.com`. Every request: `Authorization: Bearer <developer key or consent token>`. MCP endpoint `https://api.app.membase.com/mcp-http` (Streamable HTTP): the same tools by the same names, with the same arguments and answers. No request names a Memory.

## Access levels

| Level | Tools |
|---|---|
| Read (`read`) | `search_memories`, `list_memories`, `get_memory`, `list_profile_facts`, `list_documents`, `get_document`, `list_media`, `get_media`, `search_media`, `ask_memory` |
| Read & write (`suggest`) | `search_memories`, `list_memories`, `get_memory`, `add_memory`, `list_profile_facts`, `add_profile_fact`, `list_documents`, `get_document`, `add_document`, `list_media`, `get_media`, `search_media`, `ask_memory` |
| Full access (`manage`) | `search_memories`, `list_memories`, `get_memory`, `add_memory`, `forget_memory`, `list_profile_facts`, `add_profile_fact`, `forget_profile_fact`, `list_documents`, `get_document`, `add_document`, `delete_document`, `list_media`, `get_media`, `search_media`, `delete_media`, `ask_memory` |

A level is the ceiling of what a credential of that kind may hold. The profile tools and `ask_memory` are held only when a credential's tool list names them: a developer key gets the profile when the owner ticks it — reading at Read, keeping a statement at Read & write, forgetting one at Full access; `ask_memory` is what a marketplace buyer holds, and only that. A consent-minted client holds `search_memories` (the fact list and reads stand on it) and, when ticked, `list_profile_facts` — nothing else. A verb outside a credential's tools is not offered in `tools/list` and is refused with `403` when called.

## Tools and endpoints

### `get_capabilities` — What this connection can do

any credential; read-only.

`GET /v1/capabilities`

The actions this credential holds (`actions`: `search`, `memories.list`, `profile_facts.list`, …), the Memories it reaches (`memories`, by name and kind, never by id), the standing rules for using them (`rules`: `citation_required`, `retention_notice`, `version`) and the features on here. It is not permission: every call is still checked when made.

### `search_memories` — Search memories

level **Read**; read-only.

`POST /v1/search`

Passages the Memories in reach hold on a question, most relevant first. A Memory that could not answer, or whose passages all lost to `limit`, is named in `partial`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer or null | no | How many passages in all. |
| `mode` | string | no | `full`: the engine's whole retrieval. `fast`: one round, no model call. |
| `q` | string | yes | The question, in natural language. |

### `list_memories` — List memories

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/memories`

The newest facts the Memories in reach hold — newest by when it happened, the engine's own order. `has_more` says more were left out; a Memory that could not answer is named in `partial` and the others are still listed.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit (query)` | integer or null | no | How many, newest first: 1–1000, default 100. |

### `get_memory` — Get one memory

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/memories/{memory_id}`

One fact, of any age — a search can name one older than any list shows.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_id (path)` | string | yes |  |

### `add_memory` — Add a memory

level **Read & write**.

`POST /v1/memories/add`

Save one fact into this credential's write target. The answer is the note it was written as — a document of kind `note`; poll `GET /v1/documents/{id}` for its learning.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | The fact, as said. |
| `title` | string | no |  |

### `forget_memory` — Forget a memory

level **Full access**; **destructive** — `confirm=true` from a developer key, or a request.

`POST /v1/memories/{memory_id}/forget`

Forget one learned fact; the material it was learned from stays.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_id (path)` | string | yes |  |
| `confirm (query)` | boolean | no | True to carry it out (a Full access developer key). |

### `list_profile_facts` — List the user's profile

level **Read**; read-only; held only when named.

`GET /v1/profile-facts`

Who the user is: their standing statements, newest first, each with where it came from (`source_kind`: `user_stated`, `imported` or `model_generated`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit (query)` | integer or null | no | How many, newest first: 1–1000, default 100. |

### `add_profile_fact` — Add a profile fact

level **Read & write**; held only when named.

`POST /v1/profile-facts/add`

Keep one standing statement about the user. The same statement again keeps the one already there (`created: false`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | One standing statement about the user. |

### `forget_profile_fact` — Forget a profile fact

level **Full access**; **destructive** — `confirm=true` from a developer key, or a request; held only when named.

`POST /v1/profile-facts/{fact_id}/forget`

Forget one profile fact. There is no editing one: to correct it, add the new statement and forget the old.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fact_id (path)` | string | yes |  |
| `confirm (query)` | boolean | no | True to carry it out (a Full access developer key). |

### `list_documents` — List documents

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/documents`

The material the Memories in reach were given, newest first; every kind unless `kind` narrows it (a kind added later is listed too).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind (query)` | string or null | no | `file` (a file or page) or `note` (a fact as said); omit for both. |
| `limit (query)` | integer or null | no | How many, newest first: 1–1000, default 100. |

### `get_document` — Get one document

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/documents/{document_id}`

One document, with how far each Memory got in learning it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id (path)` | string | yes |  |

### `add_document` — Add a document

level **Read & write**.

`POST /v1/documents/add`

Hand in a document (text or a url) to this credential's write target.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string or null | no | The document's full text. |
| `custom_id` | string | no | Your own id; adding the same custom_id again is a no-op. |
| `title` | string | no |  |
| `url` | string or null | no | A public web address to fetch instead. |

### `delete_document` — Delete a document

level **Full access**; **destructive** — `confirm=true` from a developer key, or a request.

`POST /v1/documents/{document_id}/delete`

Withdraw a document and what every Memory learned from it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id (path)` | string | yes |  |
| `confirm (query)` | boolean | no | True to carry it out (a Full access developer key). |

### `list_media` — List photos and videos

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/media`

The photos and videos the media Memories in reach hold, newest first.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit (query)` | integer or null | no | How many, newest first: 1–1000, default 100. |

### `get_media` — Get one photo or video

level **Read**; read-only.

`GET /v1/media/{media_id}`

One photo or video with its moments: shots and spoken lines with their times, speakers and thumbnails.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media_id (path)` | string | yes |  |

### `search_media` — Search photos and videos

level **Read**; read-only.

`POST /v1/media/search`

Photos and videos matching what was seen or said, best first, each with the moments that matched (a shot or a spoken line, its time and speaker).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string or null | no | Omit for both. |
| `limit` | integer or null | no | How many items in all. |
| `q` | string | yes | What was seen or said, in any language. |

### `delete_media` — Delete a photo or video

level **Full access**; **destructive** — `confirm=true` from a developer key, or a request.

`POST /v1/media/{media_id}/delete`

Forget a photo or video and remove its file.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media_id (path)` | string | yes |  |
| `confirm (query)` | boolean | no | True to carry it out (a Full access developer key). |

### `ask_memory` — Ask the memory

level **Read**; read-only; held only when named.

`POST /v1/ask`

One answer from the memory itself — the engine reads the Memories in reach and answers once, with no agent and no tools. The citations name the Memory the answer came from, never the passages.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes | The question to answer. |

Grant names credentials minted earlier still hold; each covers its current name.

| Retired | Current |
|---|---|
| `memory_recall` | `search_memories` |
| `memory_remember` | `add_memory` |
| `memory_ingest` | `add_document` |
| `memory_list_sources` | `list_documents` |
| `memory_forget` | `delete_document` |
| `get_profile` | `list_profile_facts` |
| `ask_agent` | `ask_memory` |
| `agent_invoke` | `ask_memory` |

## Errors

| Status | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `validation` | an empty `q`; both or neither of `content` and `url`; a `limit` out of range |
| 403 | `unauthorized` | a verb above the credential's access level, or one it does not hold at all (a consent client's delete, a buyer's search) |
| 404 | `not_found` | an id that is not this credential's to read: outside its reach, deleted, or not one of ours |
| 422 | `validation` | a malformed body: a field missing, of the wrong type, or unknown (`container` included) |
| 422 | `write_target_required` | a write from a credential that reaches several Memories |
| 422 | `capability_unavailable` | the account's memory cannot run a turn here (no model) |
| 428 | `confirmation_required` | a destructive verb without `confirm=true`; nothing changed, and `details.id` names the target |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | the account's concurrent-turn budget, or too many requests on one credential |

Read `code`, not only the status: `422` is several.
